{{Quote|This is Specter-12. It's rumored he was part of a government black-ops team.|Captain Hanthor|<ref name="Mission" />}}
'''Specter-12''' was the codename of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was rumored to be part of a government black-ops unit before joining the [[Specialists]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit; Specter-12's training was unlike anything seen during the [[Galactic War]]. He commanded the [[Ghost Squad]] unit, which consisted of snipers and intel analysts, many of which utilized equipment seen on [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] personnel. He and the rest of the Specialists were [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].<ref name="Mission" />
